visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a light blue and green gradient knit sweater over a white turtleneck, stands in an outdoor urban plaza. She looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression while gesturing slightly with her hands. The background shows green bushes, paved ground, and modern white architectural structures under soft daylight. (2) A close-up shot of a digital train arrival board inside a station. The board displays Japanese text with yellow and green accents, including line names like 'JB' and destination 'Chiba'. The background shows the metallic ceiling and lighting of the station platform. (3) The camera captures the interior of a moving train. An LED display above the door shows the station name 'Iidabashi' in Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and English. A blue poster is visible on the door, and the interior is brightly lit with artificial station lights. (4) The woman is seen outside a shop entrance, followed by a cut to the interior of a restaurant named 'wanna manna'. The walls are painted a vibrant green, with a large poster of a city skyline and wooden shelves displaying packaged food products. A glass food warmer sits on the counter. (5) A graphic sequence depicts a mobile messaging interface on a light grey background. Chat bubbles in green and grey appear, containing Traditional Chinese and Japanese text. A small house icon and dates are visible at the top, simulating a smartphone screen. (6) A man wearing a light-colored dress shirt, black trousers, and a white medical mask walks into the restaurant. He looks towards the woman recording him. The camera follows his movement as he approaches and then sits down. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (7) A series of close-up shots of various food items on a green tray: a plastic-wrapped rice ball with visible sausage and egg inside, a 'mantou' steamed bun sandwich with pork and egg, a cup of soy milk tea, and sliced egg crepes (danbing) with bacon. (8) The man and woman are shown alternately eating the food. The man gives a thumbs-up to the camera with wide eyes, expressing satisfaction. The woman takes a large bite of a rice ball, then uses chopsticks to eat an egg crepe, looking happy and excited. (9) A screen recording of a mobile calculator or budgeting app shows a list of transactions from 'wanna manna' totaling 3,320 JPY, which converts to approximately 692.82 TWD. The interface is clean with grey and red accents. (10) The woman and the man pose together for a selfie-style shot. The woman makes a 'V' sign with her fingers near her face. They both look into the camera with warm, smiling expressions in a brightly lit indoor environment.
